name: River Heralds
description: The River Heralds are a merfolk nation of nine tribes on Ixalan, ancient stewards of Orazca and the nine tributaries of the Great River.

timeline.summary: Kumena arrives at the Wellspring with twenty River Heralds and a captured Sun Empire soldier.
timeline.quote: A soldier of the Sun Empire, bedraggled but whole, bound with a tangle of vines.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Following Bolas's thaumatic compass, Vraska blunders into the River Heralds' trap.
timeline.quote: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

citation.text: River's Rebuke (Ixalan Promos, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire and River Heralds are met by the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition as all race for Orazca's secret.
timeline.quote: The dinosaur -riding warriors of the Sun Empire and the merfolk shamans of the rival River Heralds are met by the vampire conquistadores of the Legion of Dusk and the pirates of the Brazen Coalition .

citation.text: "Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire abuses the Immortal Sun's power, fracturing its balance with the River Heralds and pushing the empire toward the coasts.
timeline.quote: until its abuse of the artifact’s power fractured that balance

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A prolonged war with the River Heralds causes Azcanta to sink beneath the ocean.
timeline.quote: swallowed by the ocean during a war with the River Heralds

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk crosses the seas seeking the Immortal Sun and the city of gold, building forts and clashing with the Sun Empire, River Heralds and pirates.
timeline.quote: crossed the seas in search of the Immortal Sun and the fabled city of gold

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Apatzec Intli I uses the Immortal Sun without restraint in a devastating war with the River Heralds.
timeline.quote: who had gained possession of the Immortal Sun and used it without restraint

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Apatzec Intli is gifted the Immortal Sun and misuses it; the city is ruined and abandoned, and the Sun passes to the River Heralds.
timeline.quote: He wielded the artifact without any wisdom or restraint, and the city was ruined.

citation.text: "Orazca", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, pirates and River Heralds depart; Apatzec Intli III claims the city and declares conquest of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: proclaimed a new age of conquest that would now target Torrezon

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A devastating war with the River Heralds under Apatzec Intli I reduces the empire to a few coastal cities and costs it Orazca.
timeline.quote: Following a devastating war with the River Heralds under Apatzec Intli I

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Early history". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Angrath calls every group on Ixalan ants on an anthill.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire are ants on an anthill, and so are the River Heralds and so is Torrezon and so is every other group of idiots on this plane.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The River Heralds fight a running battle against the three enemy forces.
timeline.quote: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against the three enemy forces.

citation.text: Mist-Cloaked Herald (Rivals of Ixalan, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Azor tasks the merfolk River Heralds with defending the Golden City and the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "River Heralds". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tishana arrives with her clan and confirms her agreement with Huatli stands.
timeline.quote: I assembled my clan. Our agreement stands.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.quote: I initially gifted it to a monastery in the east, in Torrezon.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli says Orazca belongs to no one and should be shared.
timeline.quote: Orazca belongs to no one,

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana agrees the River Heralds are open to negotiation.
timeline.quote: Yes. The River Heralds are.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Apatzec sends knights to clear Orazca and finds it empty.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana resolves to settle the River Heralds permanently and rename the city the City of Golden Water.
timeline.quote: The River Heralds would settle here permanently

timeline.summary: Orazca prepares for the Phyrexians and seals itself, but Phyrexian sleeper agents are trapped inside.
timeline.quote: By sealing itself in against exterior threats, the Sun Empire inadvertently trapped itself in with an unknown, terrifying, internal threat

citation.text: "Orazca", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The battle of Orazca is fought underground in the sealed city, with tens of thousands killed or turned; the city is reopened by those trapped, letting Huatli's forces in.
timeline.quote: Many tens of thousands of Imperial citizens and River Heralds died or were turned in the opening hours of the battle

citation.text: "Orazca", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: River Heralds burst out of the river and join the battle, offering to take the party to safety.
timeline.quote: A wave lashed out of the underground river, knocking two of the creatures away.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: A Herald casts a breathing spell on Wayta and shoves her into the river.

timeline.summary: River Heralds surround and capture the Legion in the water.

citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches burst out above a vast ocean and the River Heralds' city.
timeline.quote: Without warning, the tunnel ended in a short cliff.

timeline.summary: Merfolk defend their city against the fungal invasion with elementals.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan joins the party and the vampires talk their way into the Core with Sun Empire soldiers and River Heralds.
timeline.quote: The vampires convinced the party to bring them along into the Core

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saheeli asks Quint's help on Ixalan, where he helps Huatli open the caverns and reanimates Abuelo's spirit before mycoids attack.

citation.text: "Quintorius", section "On Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion hits the River Heralds hard; surviving bands flee to hidden places, most retreating to the Deeproot Tree.

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Heralds defend the Deeproot Tree through a terrible siege; Great Shapers Falani, Mitica, Notana, Tuvasa and Vuhana are killed.
timeline.quote: Great Shapers Falani, Mitica, Notana, Tuvasa , and Vuhana were killed in the Invasion.

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians are driven from the Deeproot Tree, leaving a polluted grave of a swamp.

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Without a unifying sacred site, the River Heralds' unity shatters and many resort to raids or serve other powers.

citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Matzalantli". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tishana summons all merfolk to a tribal congress, the largest assembly of merfolk bands in Ixalan's history.
